candidates.change_summary: Removed the assignment '_BASE_TARGET_ = _BASE_RESERVE_;' from the first (BELOW_ONE) branch, so _BASE_TARGET_ is no longer updated in that case.
Removed the assignment '_BASE_TARGET_ = _BASE_RESERVE_;' from the second (ABOVE_ONE) branch, so _BASE_TARGET_ is no longer updated in that case.
Changed the first branch condition '_BASE_RESERVE_<_BASE_TARGET_' to '_BASE_RESERVE_>_BASE_TARGET_', so the branch now fires (and sets _BASE_TARGET_) in the opposite reserve situation.
Changed the second branch condition '_QUOTE_RESERVE_<_QUOTE_TARGET_' to '_QUOTE_RESERVE_>_QUOTE_TARGET_', so _BASE_TARGET_ is assigned in a different set of states.
In the first branch, replaced '_BASE_TARGET_ = _BASE_RESERVE_;' with '_BASE_TARGET_ = _QUOTE_RESERVE_;', assigning the quote reserve to the base target.
In the second branch, replaced '_BASE_TARGET_ = _BASE_RESERVE_;' with '_BASE_TARGET_ = _BASE_RESERVE_ + 1;', so the base target is set one unit too high.
